audience: Israeli businesses that keep invoices and journal entries in WizCloud

useCases.title: Find the companies a token can open
useCases.text: List the companies this token can open, with their VAT numbers. Use the file name to find the database of a company.

useCases.title: Run a saved report
useCases.text: Run a report that you designed in the Report Planner and exported with the External option. The rows return as JSON.

useCases.title: Check a journal batch before it is issued
useCases.text: Check a temporary journal batch for errors. The check is read-only, and nobody has issued the batch yet.

useCases.title: Create or update a temporary invoice
useCases.text: Create or update a temporary document, such as an invoice or order. A user must issue it in WizCloud before it is stored permanently.

useCases.title: Add entries to a temporary journal batch
useCases.text: Add journal transactions to a temporary batch, then check the batch for errors. A user issues the batch in WizCloud.
